column1: # `do … error` whose handler nets NO value, followed by more program —
# §9.13) for the PROVEN-raise shape: a strict Error do-result makes the
# pass-through arm statically dead, so the zero is a FIXED arity —
# errorReturnsFn returns it truthfully, the dispatch records a 0-output
# call, and stripResidualShapeOK's want-0 arm admits the empty handler
# residual (no island, no new opcode; the row moved to the main corpus and
# is pinned native in lang/go/bytecode_do_error_arity_test.go). The
# remaining sub-frontier below: a MAYBE-raising body (a dynamic Error
# bound) has variable arity — the pass-through nets one where the caught
# path nets zero — so it keeps the refusal; graduation = the variable-arity
def xs [0] do [1 div (xs 0 getr)] error [drop] end 2 add 3
column3: a maybe-raising body with a zero-netting handler — variable arity keeps the sound refusal
